# GraphemeBreakTest-style samples for MoUI's core TextGraphemeBoundaries.
# Format mirrors Unicode GraphemeBreakTest.txt: ÷ marks a boundary and × marks
# no boundary. This curated subset is intentionally small; it establishes the
# offline generator/validation route before importing a full Unicode data file.

÷ 000D × 000A ÷ 0041 ÷ # GB3 CR x LF
÷ 0041 ÷ 0007 ÷ 0301 ÷ 0042 ÷ # GB4/GB5 controls break before Extend
÷ 0600 × 0041 ÷ # GB9b Prepend x Any
÷ 0041 × 0308 × 0301 ÷ 0042 ÷ # GB9 Extend chain
÷ 0041 ÷ 0915 × 093E ÷ 0042 ÷ # GB9a SpacingMark
÷ 0041 × 1D165 ÷ 0042 ÷ # GB9 supplementary musical Extend
÷ 1100 × 1161 × 11A8 ÷ # GB6/GB7/GB8 Hangul LVT sequence
÷ 1F1FA × 1F1F8 ÷ 1F1E8 × 1F1E6 ÷ # GB12/GB13 RI pairs
÷ 1F468 × 1F3FE × 200D × 1F680 ÷ # GB11 emoji modifier ZWJ sequence
÷ 1F468 × 200D ÷ 0041 ÷ # GB11 rejects ZWJ before non-ExtPict
÷ 2615 × FE0F ÷ 0041 ÷ # GB9 variation selector emoji presentation
÷ 0031 × FE0F × 20E3 ÷ # GB9 keycap sequence
÷ 1F3F4 × E0067 × E0062 × E007F ÷ # GB9 emoji tag sequence
÷ 0065 × 0301 × 034F ÷ 0041 ÷ # GB9 combining mark and grapheme joiner chain
÷ 0600 × 0628 × 0651 ÷ 0041 ÷ # GB9/GB9b Arabic prepend and mark cluster
÷ 0E01 × 0E34 ÷ 0041 ÷ # GB9 Thai mark
÷ 0E81 × 0EB4 ÷ 0041 ÷ # GB9 Lao mark
÷ 0D9A × 0DCF ÷ 0041 ÷ # GB9a Sinhala spacing vowel
÷ 0D9A × 0DCA × 0DBB ÷ # Indic virama Sinhala conjunct
÷ 1780 × 17B6 ÷ 0041 ÷ # GB9a Khmer vowel
÷ 1780 × 17D2 × 179A ÷ # Indic virama Khmer coeng conjunct
÷ 1000 × 1039 × 1001 ÷ # Indic virama Myanmar conjunct
÷ A960 × D7B0 × D7CB ÷ # GB6/GB7/GB8 extended Hangul Jamo sequence
÷ AC00 × 11A8 ÷ 0041 ÷ # GB8 Hangul LV x T
÷ 0915 × 094D × 200D × 0937 ÷ # Indic virama ZWJ consonant conjunct
÷ 0915 × 094D × 200D ÷ 0041 ÷ # Indic virama ZWJ before Latin breaks
÷ 0915 × 094D × 093C × 0937 ÷ # Indic virama Extend consonant conjunct
÷ 0915 × 094D × 093C ÷ 0041 ÷ # Indic virama Extend before Latin breaks
÷ 0915 × 094D × 200C ÷ 0937 ÷ # Indic virama ZWNJ breaks before consonant
